description: Catalog of every measurable pollutant and its canonical unit: id, code, display name, unit, and a one-line description (pm25, pm10, o3, no2, so2, co, bc, and more). This is the unit-disambiguation reference — the same pollutant exists under several ids with different units (CO is id 4 in µg/m³, id 8 in ppm, id 102 in ppb), so use this to pick the exact parametersId for openaq_find_locations / openaq_get_readings / openaq_get_measurements and to interpret a reading's unit. A small bounded catalog fetched live from OpenAQ.

pollutantsOnly.description: When true, exclude meteorological/auxiliary parameters (temperature, humidity, wind, pressure, particle-count channels) and return only air pollutants. Default false (full catalog).

query.description: Case-insensitive filter over the bounded parameter catalog by code, display name, and description (e.g. "pm" for particulates, "ozone", "co"). Omit to list everything.

name: openaq_list_parameters

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_error`: OpenAQ /parameters returned 5xx or an unreadable body on every retry. `rate_limited`: OpenAQ returned 429 — the request budget for this key is exhausted. `upstream_timeout`: OpenAQ /parameters did not respond within the request timeout on every retry. `invalid_api_key`: OpenAQ returned 401 — the configured OPENAQ_API_KEY is missing, invalid, or revoked. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when the query matched nothing.

parameters.description: Matching parameters. Multiple rows can share a name with different ids/units — pick the id whose unit you want.

items.description: A measurable parameter with its canonical unit

id.description: Parameter id — the precise selector for the other tools (unit-specific)

unit.description: Canonical measurement unit for this id (e.g. "µg/m³", "ppm", "ppb"). The same pollutant code appears under multiple ids with different units.

title: openaq-mcp-server: list parameters
